issue7.standard: IEEE Std 1003.1-2017 and The Open Group Base Specifications Issue 7, 2018 edition

issue8.standard: IEEE Std 1003.1-2024 and The Open Group Base Specifications Issue 8, 2024 edition

translation_rules: Preserve observable results, errors, exit status, stream contents, descriptor state, and filesystem effects before reducing storage or memory.
Use fixed bounds to reject unrepresentable input explicitly; never report success after silent truncation.
Share code, buffers, and archive members only when callers retain the required independent state and lifetime behavior.
Treat the C and POSIX byte locale as the initial tiny profile; keep locale-dependent rows partial until locale objects and collation exist.
Keep an unsupported Base requirement open. Mark a profile option unselected only after the edition source identifies the option boundary.
Require host behavior, ILP32 layout, ARMv6-M cross-linkage, Smaller C acceptance, and board evidence according to the claim being closed.
Exclude standards archives from the repository. Commit source identities, structural entity keys, paraphrased contracts, and executable evidence only.

tiny_system_mappings.tiny_translation: The target retains the existing compact FILE layout and archive split while tests bind stream ownership, pushback, modes, positions, and allocation failure.
tiny_system_mappings.residual: The mapping closes only exercised C/POSIX byte-stream behavior; complete locale, wide-stream, locking, and cancellation contracts remain open.

tiny_system_mappings.tiny_translation: The three variadic entry points share _doscan and the compact bounded string-stream constructor instead of adding a second scanner.
tiny_system_mappings.residual: Unimplemented conversion families and full locale behavior remain open rows.

tiny_system_mappings.tiny_translation: Directory streams use compact target layouts, allocation-free cookies, and selected-entry allocation while preserving descriptor admission, cleanup, and result ownership.
tiny_system_mappings.residual: Atomic open-and-CLOEXEC, general locale collation, and complete metadata-width behavior remain open.

tiny_system_mappings.tiny_translation: Arithmetic ASCII folding removes permanent tables and preserves every high byte in the fixed POSIX byte locale.
tiny_system_mappings.residual: Locale-dependent case mapping and collation remain outside the bounded mapping.

tiny_system_mappings.tiny_translation: The target reports only values backed by compile-time limits or kernel policy and rejects unknown selectors with EINVAL.
tiny_system_mappings.residual: Most required selectors and versioned execution-environment strings remain absent.

tiny_system_mappings.tiny_translation: The no-MMU kernel retains Unix process and descriptor semantics inside fixed process tables and a single 144 KiB execution window.
tiny_system_mappings.residual: The full exec error matrix, job-control shell surface, and exhaustion corpus remain open.

tiny_system_mappings.tiny_translation: The kernel keeps signal and terminal state in fixed structures; each standard row requires an executable transition and error oracle rather than a structure-presence claim.
tiny_system_mappings.residual: The complete signal, job-control, session, controlling-terminal, and asynchronous interruption matrices remain open.

tiny_system_mappings.tiny_translation: Textbox shares startup and buffering while each applet retains its option parser, byte-stream transformation, exit status, and explicit bounds.
tiny_system_mappings.residual: Each utility retains open option, locale, pathname, and error rows beyond the named host cases.

tiny_system_mappings.tiny_translation: The target uses bounded buffers and compact multicall ownership while preserving filesystem effects, write failure, and exit status as externally visible contracts.
tiny_system_mappings.residual: Recursive traversal, link, metadata, race, locale, and complete error consequences remain utility-specific open rows.

tiny_system_mappings.tiny_translation: The existing Bourne shell remains the sole shell owner; fixes reuse its parser, shared break allocator, and execution tables instead of staging a second shell.
tiny_system_mappings.residual: The declared XFAIL rows, missing command and getopts intrinsics, dollar-parenthesis substitution, arithmetic expansion, and complete grammar denominator remain open.

tiny_system_mappings.tiny_translation: The selected image retains the existing compact implementations; source presence and smoke behavior do not close either language specification.
tiny_system_mappings.residual: Both utilities require finite grammar and behavior denominators with calibrated negative controls.
